note: One sitting. First, Monday evening Japanese if it is still open (it was not on the site yesterday): 事 si6, then the Hard dakuten sets and the short recap. Then today’s short Hard only — five English cards, then four Korean cards. Say each cue aloud before you flip. No new cards, no BBC. Monday morning English is not repeated here.

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.title: Read without romaji first (only kana you know)

tasks.prompt: Write the 10 Hard items once each, saying each aloud (~3 min). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Watch the two dots on ぎ げ ざ ず ぞ.
tasks.script:
ぎ gi · げ ge · ざ za · ず zu · ぞ zo · やま yama · よる yoru · かぎ kagi · ひがし higashi · かぜ kaze
かぎ (kagi)
ひがし (higashi)
よる の やま (yoru no yama)
かぜ が つよい (kaze ga tsuyoi)
じかん が ない (jikan ga nai)

questions.explain: ぎ = き plus two dots.
ぞ = そ plus two dots.

tasks.prompt: One short workplace line. Order: Point → Reason → Example. Use one phrase from the English cards. Say it aloud, then check the script.
tasks.script:
Point: I’ll keep the reply short.
Reason: I’m frazzled, so a long email would sound sharper than I mean.
Example: Just to recap: I’ll send the draft by noon, and we can talk tomorrow.

questions.q: Tone number for 事 in 有咩事呀？
questions.explain: 事 si6, low and flat. Not 試 si3, not 時 si4.

questions.q: When you explain a work point, the order is…
questions.explain: Point, then reason, then one example.

questions.q: Fill in: Just to ___: I’ll send the draft by noon.
questions.explain: Just to recap = say the agreed points before you stop.
영수증 is the receipt. 따뜻한 걸로 주세요 is the hot one. 여섯 is six.
